snippet.title: To The Trenches Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
In 2026, To The Trenches still proves to be the ideal strategy game for any aspiring commander looking to dominate the battlefields of World War One. Empower your arsenal and soldiers with a deep upgrade tree and unique platoon enhancements while battling across procedurally generated battlefields. Earn war bonds through battles, missions and random events. Unleash devastating weapons of war such as Artillery, Gas, Armored Vehicles and War Planes. Recruit specialists and officers into your platoons to strategically overwhelm your enemies.

Grab your gear, Commander. It's time to head TO THE TRENCHES!


iOS - https://apple.co/4gtkVGO
Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dadmadethings.tothetrenches
